method: candidate alpha silhouette cropped to its foreground bounding box, nearest-neighbor scaled into the pre-measured reference bounding box, then compared with knowledge_engine.visual_compare.compare_masks
interpretation: Measured row and overlay audits localized the largest errors to blocky outer prongs, missing gem-to-collar filigree, and collar width. Typed curve-to-mesh crescents, independently editable filigree and collar lobes, and a final measured centerline correction raised IoU above the unchanged gate. The comparison method and threshold were not changed after the reference was seen.
